sql_templates.template:
SELECT 
    s.symbol, 
    COUNT(*) AS signal_count, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.hit_target THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS target_hits, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.hit_stop THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stop_hits, 
    AVG(s.return_pct) AS average_return_pct 
FROM 
    signals.signal_log s 
WHERE 
    s.date_issued >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month' 
GROUP BY 
    s.symbol 
ORDER BY 
    average_return_pct DESC 
LIMIT 10;
